ThingDef.label: cable-tool rig
ThingDef.description: A traditional drilling rig using a heavy bit suspended by a cable to pound through rock. Used for finding water or oil in the frontier.

ThingDef.label: small steam engine
ThingDef.description: A compact, coal-fired steam engine designed to provide mechanical power to nearby machinery. It must be placed near a compatible building to function.

ThingDef.label: large steam engine
ThingDef.description: A massive charcoal-fired steam engine built to drive an industrial line-shaft network. It delivers far more torque than a small steam engine, but runs hot and can explode catastrophically when damaged.

ThingDef.label: industrial diesel engine
ThingDef.description: A heavy internal-combustion engine that burns diesel to drive an industrial line-shaft network. It produces high power across a broad speed range and is more precise than a steam engine, but its fuel is costly and dangerously flammable.

ThingDef.label: large industrial motor
ThingDef.description: A large early industrial electric motor that converts electrical power into precise rotary power for a line-shaft network. It is efficient and responsive, but a severe mechanical overload can short-circuit the motor or violently discharge a connected battery.

ThingDef.label: early industrial generator
ThingDef.description: A large early industrial generator that converts line-shaft power into electricity. It is most efficient at its rated mechanical input, and loses efficiency in distinct steps as the input moves away from that point.

ThingDef.label: basic pump jack
ThingDef.description: A simple mechanical pump used to extract crude oil from a developed oil field. Requires a nearby steam engine to provide the necessary torque.

ThingDef.label: batch still
ThingDef.description: A crude batch still used to recover one selected fuel fraction from heavy crude oil. It is simple to operate, but cannot recover the other useful fractions.

ThingDef.label: distillation tower
ThingDef.description: An electrically heated fractionating column that continuously separates heavy crude oil into useful fuel fractions. It requires both electrical power and diesel fuel to operate.

ThingDef.label: kerosene lamp
ThingDef.description: A simple lamp fueled by kerosene. It provides a warm, steady light but requires regular refueling.

ThingDef.label: line shaft
ThingDef.description: A system of rotating shafts used to transmit mechanical power from a steam engine to other machines.

ThingDef.label: treadle lathe
ThingDef.description: A human-powered woodworking and metalworking lathe. Operated by a foot treadle, it allows for turning wooden and metallic components without requiring external mechanical power.

ThingDef.label: line shaft turret lathe
ThingDef.description: An advanced, line-shaft-driven metalworking lathe with a rotatable turret. Powered by the mechanical network, it allows for high-precision cutting, boring, and turning of metal components with superior speed.

ThingDef.label: line shaft milling machine
ThingDef.description: A line-shaft-driven milling machine for precision metal shaping. Powered by the mechanical network, it can cut slots, faces, and fitted parts more quickly than hand tools.

ThingDef.label: line shaft hydraulic press
ThingDef.description: A heavy hydraulic press driven by the line shaft network. It forms steel stock into springs, stamped plates, and other force-shaped metal parts.

ThingDef.label: line shaft rolling machine
ThingDef.description: A heavy rolling machine driven by the line shaft network. It squeezes heated metal stock between paired rollers to draw it into bars, plates, and other flat forms.

ThingDef.label: blast furnace
ThingDef.description: A large furnace used to smelt iron at industrial scale. It can produce batches of molten iron for later shaping and refining.

ThingDef.label: converter
ThingDef.description: A tilting steelmaking vessel used to refine molten iron with iron ore into carbon steel.

ThingDef.label: electric arc furnace
ThingDef.description: A large electric furnace that strikes powerful arcs through its electrodes to melt and refine metal. It processes heavy batches quickly, but draws an enormous amount of power while operating.

ThingDef.label: vacuum induction melting furnace
ThingDef.description: A sealed induction furnace that melts metal under vacuum. Its controlled atmosphere keeps reactive gases and contaminants out, allowing exceptionally clean and precise alloy production.

ThingDef.label: line shaft heat pump
ThingDef.description: A line-shaft-driven heat pump that fits into a wall. One side chills the air while the other dumps waste heat, with transfer strength depending on actual shaft speed.

ThingDef.label: basic workbench
ThingDef.description: A simple, hand-powered wooden workbench for basic crafting and gunsmithing tasks on the frontier. Does not require external power.

ThingDef.label: telegraph table
ThingDef.description: A specialized telegraph terminal used to transmit commercial orders and settle frontier petroleum contracts.
